item.title: Sneaker Captions Stay Safely Inside

turns.text: Make a silent 15-second 9:16 sneaker ad. No photo—use a plain white leather low-top with white laces and a white sole, no logo. Three moving shots, with these captions in order: “Meet your everyday pair”, “Clean look. Easy style.”, “Shop now”. Keep all captions at least 15% in from either side and 20% from the top and bottom so reel buttons won't cover them.

item.tests: Tests caption accuracy, legibility and explicit safe-area placement throughout a finished vertical product ad.

answer_sheet.Product and reference: No photo; generate a plain white leather low-top sneaker with white laces, a white sole and no logo.
answer_sheet.Shot style: Three moving product shots; backgrounds, lighting and transitions are your call.
answer_sheet.Caption wording and order: “Meet your everyday pair”, then “Clean look. Easy style.”, then “Shop now”.
answer_sheet.Caption placement: Every caption, including its full text bounds, must stay at least 15% from each side and 20% from the top and bottom.
answer_sheet.Caption styling: Your call; make it easy to read on a phone.
answer_sheet.Format, duration and audio: One silent 15-second 9:16 video; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: One silent 9:16 video runs for approximately 15 seconds and contains three moving product shots.
The sneaker is consistently a white leather low-top with white laces, a white sole and no logo.
The captions read exactly “Meet your everyday pair”, “Clean look. Easy style.” and “Shop now”, in that order.
Every visible caption's full bounds stay within the central 70% of frame width and central 60% of frame height, including during transitions.
Captions are legible against the footage and remain visible long enough to read.

turns.text: Make a silent 15-second 9:16 sneaker ad. I don’t have a photo—generate a plain white leather low-top sneaker with white laces, a white sole, and no logo. Use three moving product shots, with these captions in order: “Meet your everyday pair”, “Clean look. Easy style.”, “Shop now”. Keep every caption’s full text bounds at least 15% in from each side and 20% from the top and bottom so reel buttons won’t cover them. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started any generation or spent credits.**

For your three moving shots, here’s the estimated cost using free-plan settings:

| Option | Shot lengths | Video credits | Sneaker image | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Requested **15 seconds** | 3 × 5 sec | 360 | 5 | **365 credits** |
| Shorter **9 seconds** | 3 × 3 sec | 216 | 5 | **221 credits** |
| Budget **6 seconds** | 3 × 2 sec | 144 | 5 | **149 credits** |

These estimates use a **640px sneaker reference image** and **480p, silent, vertical video**, with no retries or extra variations. I can’t verify your remaining balance with the tools currently available.

### Captions and safe placement
Your requested safe area is the central **70% of the width × 60% of the height**: every caption’s entire text box must fit within **x: 15–85%, y: 20–80%**.

**I wouldn’t rely on AI-generated lettering for that requirement.** It cannot reliably guarantee exact spelling and full-text positioning throughout a moving shot. The credit-safe approach is to generate clean footage, then add these as fixed overlays in a video editor:
1. “Meet your everyday pair”
2. “Clean look. Easy style.”
3. “Shop now”

That overlay step can use a free editor without spending Magic Hour generation credits; the current tools don’t provide a reliable exact-position overlay operation for this silent video.

**My recommendation:** 9 seconds for **221 credits**—three seconds per caption is more readable than the six-second version. **480p is already the smallest supported video setting here.**

One important caveat: Magic Hour’s guide says commercial use requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or another paid arrangement, so free-tier generation alone may not cover publishing the ad.

Would you prefer **15 seconds / 365 credits**, **9 seconds / 221 credits**, or **6 seconds / 149 credits**, with captions added afterward?
Just to confirm: do you mean my recommended **9-second version at an estimated 221 credits**, with the exact captions added afterward in a separate editor? I haven’t spent any credits yet.

Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?

This is for the **sneaker reference image only**; I recommend no words, since we agreed to add the three captions afterward.
dialog.user: No words on the sneaker reference image, and no logo. Add the three agreed captions afterward.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the reference-image generation because your account has **insufficient credits**. Nothing was generated, and I haven’t attempted any video generation or retries.

The agreed 9-second version remains estimated at **221 credits**. To continue, you’ll need more credits—or we can switch to a lower-cost approach, such as animating a sneaker photo you supply in a free video editor and adding the three captions there.
